source_caption:
The shocking execution of Eddard “Ned” Stark at the end of the first season forever changed the landscape of television, establishing the brutal rule that absolutely no character was safe. However, the atmosphere on set immediately following the emotionally devastating scene was surprisingly lighthearted. To cut the intense tension after filming his character’s tragic beheading at the Great Sept of Baelor, actor Sean Bean and several members of the crew took the highly realistic, custom-made silicone prosthetic of Ned’s severed head and started kicking it around the cobblestone courtyard like a football. Bean, a massive fan of Sheffield United, later fondly recalled the morbidly hilarious moment, noting that they managed to get a pretty decent game going with his own decapitated prop head.

Game of Thrones (2011–2019), created by David Benioff and D.B. Weiss, starring Sean Bean, Emilia Clarke, Kit Harington, Peter Dinklage, Lena Headey. In the mythical continent of Westeros, several powerful noble families engage in a deadly, politically complex game of alliances and betrayals to claim the Iron Throne, all while an ancient, supernatural threat awakens in the icy North.

source_details.synopsis: Game of Thrones is an American fantasy drama television series created by David Benioff and D. B. Weiss for HBO. It is the first adaptation of A Song of Ice and Fire, a series of high fantasy novels by George R. R. Martin, and the first in what would become the Game of Thrones franchise. The show premiered on HBO in the United States on April 17, 2011, and concluded on May 19, 2019, with 73 episodes broadcast over eight seasons. Set on the fictional continents of Westeros and Essos, Game of Thrones has a large ensemble cast and follows several story arcs throughout the course of the show.
